Thanks for the context. A few accounting notes up front:

- Pass-through vs Redwood-billed: If Northstar elects AWS Consolidated Billing (AWS-as-seller passthrough), AWS issues the invoice and we rely on marketplace fulfillment records. In the Redwood-billed model (Redwood as the seller-of-record), we issue a single invoice to you and reconcile with AWS settlement reports.
- Tax & proration: For concurrent-seat SKUs we recommend contract language that clarifies daily averaging for pro-rated first/last months to keep invoice lines predictable.
- Disputes & credits: Standard policy is automated backfill for delayed metering events within 30 days. After 30 days, finance ticket with evidence (AWS usage report + webhook logs) is required for manual credit.

Karthik: can you confirm the webhook behavior when AWS reports a revised usage event (re-ingestion / resubmission)? We need the exact sequence so Sara's team can see timing for reconciliation.

-Ben
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: billing-playbook-excerpt.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)]

Sara / team — following up with the technical sequence and attached artifacts. TL;DR below, full attachments linked.

TL;DR:
- Metering event flow: AWS -> Marketplace Metering API -> Redwood ingestion -> immediate provisional entitlement update (used for quota enforcement) -> daily batch writes to usage ledger -> Redshift settlement export.
- Retry/Correction: If AWS replays or corrects an event within 0-72 hours we auto-merge (idempotent ingestion). Corrections that arrive between 72 hours and 30 days are recorded as adjustment events and shown as "adjustment" lines on Redwood invoices with a reference to the original AWS event id. After 30 days, adjustments require a finance ticket and manual review.
- Invoices: We provide a mock invoice example in the CSV and a consolidated mapping diagram in the draw.io export. For the SOW, add the clause: "Metering corrections within 30 days will be handled via automated adjustment; corrections after 30 days are subject to manual reconciliation and potential crediting dependent on evidence."

Attachments provided: proposed_sku_map.csv, integration_sequence.drawio, northstar-docusign-sow-link.txt (DocuSign URL + signing instructions).
